Method of Attack: Ransomware deployment targeting law enforcement agency network in Passaic County, New Jersey
Discoverer: Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
Impacted Systems: Law enforcement agency network in Passaic County, New Jersey
Attack Vector: Ransomware operations targeting U.S. businesses and critical infrastructure
Indicators of Compromise: Association with ransomware variants Hive, LockBit, Babuk
Sanction by OFAC for cyberattacks against U.S. critical infrastructure and law enforcement
Reward announced by U.S. Department of State under TOCRP for information leading to arrest or conviction
